audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Numbers / Bemidbar staffs-and-budding-sign text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for twelve tribal staffs, Aaron's staff for Levi, overnight sign before testimony, buds/blossoms/almonds, preservation of the staff, and the people's fear. Anti-authoritarian safeguards required.

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

modern.text: And the LORD said to Moses,

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel and take from them one staff for each fathers' house, from all their leaders according to fathers' houses, twelve staffs; each man's name you shall write upon his staff.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man’s name upon his rod.

modern.text: “Speak to the Israelites and take from them twelve staffs, one from the leader of each tribe. Write each man’s name on his staff,

original.text: דַּבֵּ֣ר אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְקַ֣ח מֵֽאִתָּ֡ם מַטֶּ֣ה מַטֶּה֩ לְבֵ֨ית אָ֜ב מֵאֵ֤ת כָּל נְשִֽׂיאֵהֶם֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר מַטּ֑וֹת אִ֣ישׁ אֶת שְׁמ֔וֹ תִּכְתֹּ֖ב עַל מַטֵּֽהוּ

verses.restored: Aaron's name you shall write upon staff of Levi, for one staff shall be for head of each fathers' house.

familiar.text: And thou shalt write Aaron’s name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.

modern.text: and write Aaron’s name on the staff of Levi, because there must be one staff for the head of each tribe.

original.text: וְאֵת֙ שֵׁ֣ם אַהֲרֹ֔ן תִּכְתֹּ֖ב עַל מַטֵּ֣ה לֵוִ֑י כִּ֚י מַטֶּ֣ה אֶחָ֔ד לְרֹ֖אשׁ בֵּ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽם

verses.restored: You shall place them in tent of meeting before testimony, where I meet with you.

familiar.text: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.

modern.text: Place the staffs in the Tent of Meeting in front of the Testimony, where I meet with you.

original.text: וְהִנַּחְתָּ֖ם בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לִפְנֵי֙ הָֽעֵד֔וּת אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לָכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה

verses.restored: It shall be that staff of man whom I choose shall bud, and I will cause murmurings of children of Israel against you to cease from before me.

familiar.text: And it shall come to pass, that the man’s rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.

modern.text: The staff belonging to the man I choose will sprout, and I will rid Myself of the constant grumbling of the Israelites against you.”

original.text: וְהָיָ֗ה הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶבְחַר בּ֖וֹ מַטֵּ֣הוּ יִפְרָ֑ח וַהֲשִׁכֹּתִ֣י מֵֽעָלַ֗י אֶת תְּלֻנּוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם מַלִּינִ֖ם עֲלֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Moses spoke to children of Israel, and all their leaders gave him one staff for each leader, one staff for each fathers' house, twelve staffs; staff of Aaron was among their staffs.

familiar.text: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.

modern.text: So Moses spoke to the Israelites, and each of their leaders gave him a staff—one for each of the leaders of their tribes, twelve staffs in all. And Aaron’s staff was among them.

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ אֵלָ֣יו כָּֽל נְשִֽׂיאֵיהֶ֡ם מַטֶּה֩ לְנָשִׂ֨יא אֶחָ֜ד מַטֶּ֨ה לְנָשִׂ֤יא אֶחָד֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר מַטּ֑וֹת וּמַטֵּ֥ה אַהֲרֹ֖ן בְּת֥וֹךְ מַטּוֹתָֽם

verses.restored: Moses placed staffs before YHWH in tent of testimony.

familiar.text: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.

modern.text: Then Moses placed the staffs before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony.

original.text: וַיַּנַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת הַמַּטֹּ֖ת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּאֹ֖הֶל הָעֵדֻֽת

verses.restored: On next day Moses entered tent of testimony, and look, staff of Aaron for house of Levi had budded; it brought forth buds, blossomed blossoms, and ripened almonds.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

modern.text: The next day Moses entered the Tent of the Testimony and saw that Aaron’s staff, representing the house of Levi, had sprouted, put forth buds, blossomed, and produced almonds.

original.text: וַיְהִ֣י מִֽמָּחֳרָ֗ת וַיָּבֹ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל הָעֵד֔וּת וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּרַ֥ח מַטֵּֽה אַהֲרֹ֖ן לְבֵ֣ית לֵוִ֑י וַיֹּ֤צֵֽא פֶ֨רַח֙ וַיָּ֣צֵֽץ צִ֔יץ וַיִּגְמֹ֖ל שְׁקֵדִֽים

verses.restored: Moses brought out all staffs from before YHWH to all children of Israel; they saw, and each man took his staff.

familiar.text: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

modern.text: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from the LORD’s presence to all the Israelites. They saw them, and each man took his own staff.

original.text: וַיֹּצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת כָּל הַמַּטֹּת֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל כָּל בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּרְא֥וּ וַיִּקְח֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ מַטֵּֽהוּ

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Return staff of Aaron before testimony, to be kept as sign for sons of rebellion, so you may finish their murmurings from before me, and they not die.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron’s rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.

modern.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Put Aaron’s staff back in front of the Testimony, to be kept as a sign for the rebellious, so that you may put an end to their grumbling against Me, lest they die.”

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה הָשֵׁ֞ב אֶת מַטֵּ֤ה אַהֲרֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָעֵד֔וּת לְמִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת לְא֖וֹת לִבְנֵי מֶ֑רִי וּתְכַ֧ל תְּלוּנֹּתָ֛ם מֵעָלַ֖י וְלֹ֥א יָמֻֽתוּ

verses.restored: Moses did so; as YHWH commanded him, so he did.

familiar.text: And Moses did so: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.

modern.text: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded him.

original.text: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה

verses.restored: Children of Israel said to Moses, Look, we perish, we are lost, all of us are lost!

familiar.text: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.

modern.text: Then the Israelites declared to Moses, “Look, we are perishing! We are lost; we are all lost!

original.text: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵ֥ן גָּוַ֛עְנוּ אָבַ֖דְנוּ כֻּלָּ֥נוּ אָבָֽדְנוּ

verses.restored: Everyone drawing near, drawing near to dwelling-place of YHWH, dies. Are we completely to perish?

familiar.text: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?

modern.text: Anyone who comes near the tabernacle of the LORD will die. Are we all going to perish?”

original.text: כֹּ֣ל הַקָּרֵ֧ב הַקָּרֵ֛ב אֶל מִשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה יָמ֑וּת הַאִ֥ם תַּ֖מְנוּ לִגְוֺֽעַ

translation_notes: The twelve staffs represent tribal leadership before YHWH; Aaron's staff is one among them until the sign occurs.
The budding staff settles the specific dispute over priestly approach after Numbers 16; it does not make Aaron or later leaders immune from accountability.
Bud, blossom, and ripe almonds appear together as concentrated life imagery emerging from dead wood.
The people's final fear shows that the sign does not automatically restore trust or felt safety; chapter 18 responds with clearer boundaries and responsibilities.
safety_note: Do not use Numbers 17 to silence criticism, demand unquestioning loyalty, or claim that religious office proves moral perfection. The staff is a specific narrative sign concerning priestly vocation, not a universal license for authoritarian leadership.
